points.description: States that a leaf is a node with no children (a node at the bottom/end of a tree with nothing below it).
points.partial_credit: 2-3 marks if related but vague or incomplete, e.g. says it is an end/last node of a tree without mentioning having no children, or says it is a node with no further links.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying a leaf is a node with no children, in any wording (e.g. 'end node of a tree', 'node with nothing below it'). Give part marks for vague or incomplete answers that are on the right track, such as 'last node' or 'bottom of the tree'. No marks for unrelated ideas, such as describing the root or a parent node. Extra remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the idea.
